title: This Startup Is Freezing Bone Marrow From Deceased Donors To Save Cancer Patients’ Lives
summary: Ossium Health pioneered a way to cryopreserve bone marrow and completed more than two dozen successful transplants. Now it wants to scale up its technology so anyone who needs bone marrow can access it quickly.
